name: One Montague Place (205 & 181 Montague)
address: 205 Montague St at Cadman Plaza West, with air rights from 181 Montague St
eyebrow: New building · as of right · Brooklyn Community District 2
intro: A roughly 50-story luxury condo and rental tower going up across from Borough Hall, on the site of a 1962 office building that replaced the old Brooklyn Dodgers headquarters [[sixsqft]]. It's being built on a zoning lot merged with its neighbors [[acriszone]], including the landmark People's Trust Company Building at 181 Montague, whose unused air rights were bought for the tower [[acrisair]].

status.headline: Built as of right, so there's no public review to track
paragraphs: Construction started in July 2026 after demolition of the office building finished in June [[sixsqft,holt]]. Completion is targeted for 2029, and condo sales are expected to launch in 2027 [[sixsqft]]. The condo offering plan was submitted to the State Attorney General on Feb 2, 2026 and is awaiting acceptance [[cityrealty]].

The tower needed no rezoning: City Planning has no application for either lot, so there is no ULURP, Community Board vote or Council vote. Its extra height comes from a zoning lot merger: in May 2026 the developer bought 181 Montague's unused development rights for $4,182,000 [[acrisair]] and recorded a zoning lot declaration covering 205 and 181 Montague, the 195 Montague condos and 142–146 Pierrepont [[acriszone]]. Saint Ann's School is a party to one of the agreements [[acrissage]]. An "air rights subdivision" for 181 Montague followed at the Buildings Department on Oct 29, 2026 [[dobair]].

The landmark bank building at 181 Montague stays. Any change to its exterior would need a public Landmarks hearing [[lpc]]. What's left to watch is construction permits and complaints, the offering plan's acceptance and sales, and anything filed for 181 itself.

facts: Landau Properties, Third Millennium Group, Midtown Equities [[sixsqft]]
About 672 ft [[sixsqft]]. Reported as 47 [[urbanize]] to 51 stories [[eagle51]]; DOB filings say 51 [[dobnb]]
136: 46 condos (3+ bedrooms, from ~3,000 sf) and 90 rentals [[sixsqft]]
Jazz club, 63-ft indoor pool, four padel courts, children's playrooms [[sixsqft]]
19,000 sf [[sixsqft]]; bought Dec 2025 with pre-development financing [[cityrealty]]

watch.p: A 51-story build [[dobnb]] on a tight site across from Borough Hall means street and sidewalk closures, crane permits and work next to 195 Montague (DOB has already permitted roof protection there [[dobroof]]). New DOB permits show up in Updates.

At about 672 ft it would be among Brooklyn's tallest buildings [[sixsqft]]. Because it's as of right, there was no environmental review of shadows on Columbus Park, Cadman Plaza or the historic district.
The air-rights sale [[acrisair]] leaves the landmark with little room to grow. Any exterior change still needs a public LPC hearing [[lpc]].
Saint Ann's is a party to the May 2026 agreements [[acrissage]], which may cover light, air or access for its Pierrepont Street buildings. The recorded document would say.

footer: Watched records: Buildings Department filings and ACRIS recorded documents for 205 Montague (244/1) and 181 Montague (244/15) [[acriszone]]. There's no City Planning application for either lot.
